Hi Sam  quick answers inline.

> 1) For the p99 numbers, what was the tail caused by? network variance or model/kernel cold starts?

Mostly KV-cache refill and occasional GC pauses on the node when serving longer sequences back-to-back. Not pure network jitter. In these runs we intentionally hit mixed sequence lengths which surfaces the cache refill tail. We can mitigate by:
- pre-warming KV cache for expected short-turn traffic profiles
- limiting max batch size for low-latency routes and routing higher-batch work to a separate pool
- enabling soft real-time scheduling on Dedicated pools

> 2) What batch size distribution produced the avg batch size of 3? We run highly concurrent small requests (lots of single-turn chats).

Distribution: ~62% single-request batches, 28% batches of 2-4, 10% >4. Since you have many single-turn chats, we recommend configuring dynamic batch thresholds to prefer latency (max_batch_size=4, batch_timeout_ms=8)  this typically gets p95 under 300ms while preserving throughput.

PoC estimate (very rough):
- 2-week PoC for 100k requests/day (avg 20 tokens per request): ~2.8M tokens total/day -> estimate 84M tokens over 30 days equivalent; for 2 weeks ~39M tokens.
- Hosted trial w/ small dedicated pool: ~$6k-$9k for the 2-week period (includes modest dedicated capacity and data-in-place retention for logs).

If you want an itemized quote I can prep one  Marissa, can you add procurement steps & SOC2 bundle?

Cheers,
